name: Server & Web Security
summary: Watch and test the security of servers and sites you own — defensively.
description: Checks the servers and websites you own or may test: which ports and services are open, whether TLS certificates are valid and strong, whether security headers and CORS are set, how a site's firewall (WAF) handles common attack-shaped requests, and this Girru's own security settings. Every finding is informational, carries the exact request/response that proves it, and can be retested until it is marked fixed. An optional sensor you install on your own server pushes live alerts (a new open port, a certificate about to expire, a spike in failed logins) into Girru. It never attacks, exploits, logs in to, or controls anything, and it only ever tests targets you have confirmed you own.
permissions: Checks the servers and sites you add and confirm you own (ports, TLS, headers, firewall behaviour)
Refuses local and private network addresses unless you allow them in Settings
Runs your scheduled campaigns in the background, checked once an hour
Checks this Girru's own address when you run a self-audit
Receives alerts that a sensor you installed pushes from your own server
Keeps its scans, findings, evidence and settings in its own tables
Adds a waf_scan tool that agents can use only after you allow it
